description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateTaskButton class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate to provide a custom button for creating new Task records within a subpanel context in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods to generate the required HTML form and display logic for the button.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateTaskButton
classes.description: A widget class that renders a button to create a new Task from a subpanel in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, extending the quick create button class to include specific behavior for Tasks.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for the 'Create Task' button, including hidden fields with context-specific data such as parent record IDs and module names.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML for displaying the button if the user has edit access to Task records; otherwise, returns an empty string.
